title: Managing the purchase requisition approval process on Mac: a guide for procurement specialists
metaTitle: Purchase Requisition Approval Process: Fixes and Workflow Tips for Mac Users
description: Struggling with slow purchase requisition approval processes? Learn how to identify bottlenecks, fix manual workflows, and use your Mac more efficiently.
intro: The purchase requisition approval process is often the biggest bottleneck in your daily procurement workflow. When requests stall in email chains or disconnected spreadsheets, you spend more time chasing signatures than doing strategic work.
tldr: Most procurement delays stem from manual, email-based approval chains.
Nearly 70% of procurement leaders report high stress due to these operational inefficiencies.
You can fix this by centralizing your intake and using risk-based thresholds.
Lazur helps by pointing out bottlenecks on your screen and drafting status updates.
Modern procurement tools run in your browser on macOS, so you do not need specific Mac-only software.

blocks.text: Why the purchase requisition approval process breaks

The core issue is friction. When you rely on disconnected tools like Excel spreadsheets, long email threads, and siloed legacy systems, the process becomes reactive. You are constantly firefighting instead of planning.

items: Manual workload: You spend hours manually entering data and reconciling documents.
Lack of visibility: Requests get lost in transit, and approvers lack context on budget impact.
Human factor: When processes are slow, stakeholders bypass them to meet deadlines, creating more work for you.

blocks.text: What manual approval processes cost you

The cost of a broken purchase requisition approval process goes beyond lost time. It impacts your team's mental health and the company bottom line. About 55% of procurement teams report higher burnout rates than in previous years. This is often called procurement fatigue.
Fixing your workflow without new software

You do not always need to buy expensive software to see improvements. Start by mapping your current approval journey. You cannot improve what you do not measure. Identify exactly where requests stall. Is it a specific department? A certain type of request?

items: Implement risk-based thresholds: Stop treating a five dollar office supply request the same as a five thousand dollar software contract.
Standardize email templates: If you must use email, use a strict template in Outlook to ensure all data is present before it reaches the approver.
Centralize communication: Move status updates out of individual email chains and into a shared space or Slack channel.

blocks.text: Use the macOS ⌘ ⌥ ⌃ ⇧ shortcuts to manage your windows. Keeping your ERP system and your communication tool side by side reduces context switching.

blocks.text: How Lazur helps with procurement workflows
Lazur acts as a voice assistant for your Mac. It helps you manage the administrative side of procurement without needing to click through complex menus.

faq.question: Does my procurement software need to be native to macOS?
faq.answer: No. Most modern procurement platforms like Coupa, Zip, or Procurify are cloud-based and run perfectly in Chrome or Safari on your Mac.

faq.question: Can Lazur click buttons in my ERP system?
faq.answer: No. Lazur does not click buttons, edit files, or operate other apps for you. It can guide you through the steps or point at the button you need to click.
